turns.assistant_response:
The parties in this contract are JEA (the Discloser) and the Recipient.

[EVIDENCE: "by and between JEA, located at 21 West Church Street, Jacksonville, Florida 32202 (the "Discloser"), and ____________________________________________________________ with an address at ______________________________________________ (the "Recipient")] 

The contract specifies that the parties are referred to as "Discloser" and "Recipient" throughout the document. The Recipient's name and address are placeholders that need to be filled in by the actual party entering into the agreement with JEA. 

[EVIDENCE: "WHEREAS, the Recipient desires to work with the discloser and/or view ______________________________________________________________________documents regarding ____________________________________ (the "Transaction");"]

This evidence further confirms that the Recipient is the entity that desires to work with JEA on a specific transaction. 

There is no mention of additional parties such as agents, representatives, consultants, or financial advisors being included as part of the "Representatives" of the parties unless specifically approved by the Discloser. Therefore, the primary parties are JEA and the Recipient.
